first_entry_target: same-session observed strictly later High; earliest tied High bar

old_baseline_geometry: canonical fields reused; numerical parity only; new Path Q/D/TV/reversal measured using unchanged saved baseline fill
selector_future_MFE: saved canonical full-session evaluator first-selector authority; admitted full-session status does not imply every 1m observed
peak_bar_intrabar_order: UNKNOWN; earliest max-High bar Low conservatively included in pre-peak MAE
historical_actual_known_at: UNKNOWN; bar-end availability is research assumption
